instruction.text: Select everything that is included in the term on the left.
Select the top that helps you be seen more easily when walking along the road.
Select the safest place to walk along the road.
Correctly order the steps of crossing the road safely.

atoms.b: Find a safe place to cross.
Stop just before you get to the kerb.
Look all around for traffic and listen.
If traffic is coming, let it pass.
When it is safe, go straight across the road - do not run.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: You should run when crossing the road to get to the other side quickly.
A lollipop person can help you cross the road safely.
You should always try and use pedestrian crossings to cross the road.
It’s still safe to start crossing when the green man is flashing.
